repo_audit.summary: Signs '/portfolio/balance' without '/trade-api/v2' prefix; fixed in kalshi_engine/kalshi_v2_client.py.
Posts V1 schema to removed POST /portfolio/orders instead of V2 POST /portfolio/events/orders.
Checks market.status === 'settled' (query filter) instead of 'finalized' and never polls ?status=settled.
Renders checkboxes/flags for favorite & longshot strategies that execute zero trades.
Renders lowest $0.01 bids at top instead of [-1] best bid and truncates no_dollars when longer than yes_dollars.
Committed empty (events:[]) in git; legacy main:/ Pages serves empty JSON before browser polling.
Filters result to ['yes','no'] only, dropping finalized binary contracts with result='scalar' ($0.5000).
Defaults KALSHI_DATA_ENV='prod' (external-api.kalshi.com) rather than Kalshi Demo API; live/ provides verified Demo data.
Marks fee formula unverified (ceil_to_cent); official docs specify 6dp rounding + subpenny/cent accumulator.

Scheduled 30m/60m jobs committed data/live/* and data/account.json without running scripts/build-site.mjs, turning 19 generated HTML pages and AUD-08 stale after every cycle; fixed in session 3f5311c5.
Python collector updated docs/desk/data/latest.json every 30m without running live/build_page.py, causing live/build_page.py --check to fail in pages.yml.
Retained seed note 'No simulated position has been opened yet... The record is empty' after opening 8 real Demo positions; cleared in session 3f5311c5.
openPosition/markToMarket ignored series.fee_multiplier, and browser JS defaulted relayUrl to 127.0.0.1 instead of same-origin relative /api/demo/*; fixed in session 3f5311c5.
